/-- **π₆ of the 3-sphere.** Toda's tables give `π₆(𝕊³) ≅ ℤ/12`. -/
theorem pi6_sphere_three_mulEquiv_zmod_twelve
    (x : Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 4)) 1) :
    Nonempty
      (HomotopyGroup.Pi 6 (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 4)) 1) x ≃*
        Multiplicative (ZMod 12)) := by
  sorry
